blocks.html: Yellowfin Tuna Fishing in Cabo – Private Charters from San José del Cabo

Premium Tuna Fishing at Puerto Los Cabos Marina

Experience the excitement of tuna fishing in Cabo with Exotic Fish Cabo.

The waters of the Sea of Cortez offer opportunities to target powerful yellowfin tuna, one of the most exciting game fish found around Los Cabos.

Our private tuna fishing charters depart from Puerto Los Cabos Marina in San José del Cabo, with access to offshore fishing grounds such as Gordo Banks and Iman Bank.

Our experienced local captains adapt fishing techniques and locations to seasonal tuna activity, bait availability, and ocean conditions.

Whether you're chasing your first yellowfin tuna or hoping to challenge a larger fish, Exotic Fish Cabo offers private fishing adventures for different experience levels.

Why Book Tuna Fishing With Exotic Fish Cabo?

    • Convenient Departure: All charters depart from Puerto Los Cabos Marina in San José del Cabo, with access to offshore fishing grounds such as Gordo Banks and Iman Bank.

    • Local Fishing Knowledge: Experienced local crews adapt fishing locations and techniques to current ocean conditions.

    • Private Charters: Choose from private fishing boats accommodating different group sizes, from couples to larger groups.

    • Flexible Trip Options: Private 6-hour and 8-hour fishing charters are available, with boat selection based on your preferences and fishing goals.

    • Clear Inclusions: Fishing equipment, bottled water, and soft drinks are included. Additional services and costs are confirmed before booking.

Yellowfin Tuna Season in Los Cabos

Departing from Puerto Los Cabos Marina in San José del Cabo gives anglers convenient access to renowned tuna fishing grounds such as Gordo Banks and Iman Bank.

Whether you're staying in Cabo San Lucas or San José del Cabo, Exotic Fish Cabo offers private tuna fishing charters with experienced local captains who select fishing locations based on seasonal tuna activity, ocean conditions, and your fishing goals.

Tuna Fishing Calendar

Yellowfin tuna fishing opportunities exist throughout the year in Los Cabos, although activity varies with water temperature, ocean currents, and baitfish availability.

Summer and fall often provide favorable conditions for offshore tuna fishing, while opportunities can also occur during the cooler months.

The size and abundance of tuna cannot be predicted reliably from the month alone. Actual fishing conditions should guide trip planning.

For a broader seasonal overview, explore our Cabo Fishing Calendar.

The Exotic Fish Cabo Tuna Experience

Target Species:

Our tuna fishing charters in San Jose del Cabo target multiple species depending on season and conditions:

  • Yellowfin Tuna (Ahi): The star attraction—powerful fighters from 30 to 300+ pounds

  • Skipjack Tuna: Fast, abundant, perfect for beginners and family trips

  • Bigeye Tuna: Less common but often larger, deep-dwelling trophies

Where We Fish

Our private tuna fishing charters depart from Puerto Los Cabos Marina in San José del Cabo, providing access to offshore fishing grounds in the Sea of Cortez.

Depending on weather conditions, currents, and recent tuna activity, fishing areas may include Gordo Banks, Iman Bank, and other suitable offshore locations.

Yellowfin tuna often concentrate around underwater structure, baitfish schools, and productive current boundaries. Our local crews adapt fishing techniques and locations to the conditions encountered during each trip.

Specific fishing areas and catches cannot be guaranteed.

Techniques & Gear

Navigation & Fish-Finding Equipment: Available electronics vary by boat. Our crews combine local fishing knowledge, navigation tools, and observations of ocean conditions to identify suitable fishing areas.

What's Included in Your Tuna Charter

    • Experienced local captain and crew, as applicable to the selected boat

    • Fishing rods, reels, and basic tackle

    • Bottled water and soft drinks

    Fishing licenses, live bait, meals, transportation, fish-cleaning services, and any additional fees should be confirmed before booking.

Tuna Fishing Tips for Los Cabos

  1. Book Full-Day Trips: Yellowfin often require 6-8 hours to reach the best offshore grounds

  2. Bring Sun Protection: Cabo sun is intense—hat, polarized sunglasses, and reef-safe sunscreen essential

  3. Stay Hydrated: Tuna fights are physically demanding; drink plenty of water

  4. Trust Your Captain: These waters are their backyard—they know where tuna run

  5. Be Ready: When a yellowfin strikes, the fight starts immediately—no warning!

From Ocean to Table

Yellowfin tuna is prized for its rich flavor and versatility. If you catch tuna and choose to keep it within Mexican fishing regulations, our team can explain available fish-cleaning options and help you find local restaurants that may prepare your catch. Please confirm availability and any additional fees before your trip.

Book Your San Jose del Cabo Tuna Charter

Ready to experience yellowfin tuna fishing in Cabo?

Exotic Fish Cabo offers private 6-hour and 8-hour fishing charters departing from Puerto Los Cabos Marina in San José del Cabo.

Whether you're an experienced offshore angler or planning your first tuna fishing adventure, our team can help you select a suitable boat and prepare for your trip.

Explore our private fishing charter options or contact us to check availability, pricing, and seasonal fishing opportunities.

Book your private tuna fishing adventure with Exotic Fish Cabo!
